rows.en: "That's right, Oyassan's got a point!" "But still, even so…"
Why not go proudly, as the Science Patrol's representative?

I mean… you can't just abandon your friends, right?

It's struggling on the front line that shows what a man's really worth.
…!? Ide? That's rare. Off duty today?
What's wrong?
Huh… But that's amazing!? Why are you so torn about it?

Hmm… Helping out the TDF doesn't mean you're quitting the Science Patrol!

Why not go help them with your Science Patrol badge still on, and your head held high? Right, [HERO2]?
"Yes, Oyassan's right!" "But still, even so…"
Why don't you go proudly, as the Science Patrol's representative?

I mean… you can't abandon your friends, can you?

It's struggling on the front line that shows what a man's really worth.

I see… Yeah, you're right!

Man… it's tough being so popular. Well then, everyone…
What? Just how seriously was he worrying about it? Look at him, acting like nothing happened…
We got it!
No, it got away! It must have burrowed deep underground!!
Kishidaaa!!
Kishidaaa!!
Go…!
Ugh… A… Akane…
Mr. Kishida!?
You're not from Earth, are you?

I see! That kaiju has something to do with you, doesn't it?

You used that kaiju to try to destroy the radar… along with Kishida, the man who developed it, didn't you?
That's not true! Please believe me… Please listen to what I have to say!
I'll listen…

Granadas and I came to Earth from the Centaurus star to destroy the radar.

But… while I was waiting for the right moment, I came to love this planet of kind-hearted humans.
And so… because you betrayed your own planet, Granadas nearly killed you?

Yes…

But… to think that Mr. Kishida, who saved my life, is the one who developed the radar…!

I'm… a wicked alien who tried to destroy that radar! I'm no longer allowed to see Mr. Kishida!

Someday… the time will come when I have to tell him the truth.
Kishida loves you!

I love him too…!

It hurts so much!! I've fallen in love with a man I must not love… I can't even go back to my own planet anymore!

Somewhere… somewhere no one knows me, I'll go on loving him quietly, all alone…
What's wrong!?

An order has come from my planet! At this rate, the radar will be completed.

They're telling Granadas to use the last of its strength to destroy the radar!

If the radar is successfully destroyed, my people will come to invade Earth.
What!?
Mr. Go… hurry, to the radar base! I'll come with you.
But…
No… I'm the only one who knows how to beat Granadas…

Another kaiju has appeared!

Listen! We defend the radar base to the death, no matter what!
Let's go!!

…!?

Akane!? Go, what are you doing!? Bringing Akane to a place like this!
I came to say my final goodbye…
Final…?
It's dangerous! Please, just get somewhere safe!
Mr. Kishida…
Goodbye, Mr. Kishida…
Huh…!?
I'm sorry… I'm an alien who came to destroy MAT's radar.
No…? That's crazy!?
Inside my body, there are enough explosives planted to destroy the radar.
That's a lie!
You'll understand soon… I love you so very much! Goodbye…!
Come back! Come back here!!

Jamila, forgive us…

But it's all right, isn't it? This way, you can become part of Earth's soil! The soil of your homeland, Earth…
Kishida, please, cheer up…

Kishida… what you did was truly wonderful!

You're the first person on this Earth to touch an alien's heart.

Akane was a pure-hearted person too…
"Here sleeps the soul of a warrior who died for mankind's dreams and the advancement of science"… huh. A fitting epitaph for him.
Let us offer a moment of silence for an alien who fought bravely for the people of Earth! Salute!!
"It's always like this for the victims! The words are beautiful, but that's all…"

Oh, that's right!

I should tell all of you…

From now on, Ide will be helping out the TDF's science group… so he may have fewer chances to go out to the front line with us!
Ide… Don't tell me you…?

Don't get the wrong idea…

It's not like I'm going to the TDF's science group because I got sick of my Science Patrol duties!

I realized they need my skills to invent new weapons!
Good on you for making up your mind.
Good luck, Ide…
Everyone…
Akane, the alien who saved the Earth… Jamila, the Earthman who returned from space as a monster…
The visitors from space each met their own end… Before long, the world is wrapped in darkness, and the sky full of stars shines as brightly as ever…
Hey, is everyone all right?

Captain…

…!?
Oka…! And Akane…

I was keeping Akane safe…

And… she told me the whole story.
Isn't that great, Kishida…
Yeah… Ah, w-well, I guess…
I heard from Go… You're getting married, huh?
What's that? Why, you… you blabbed to everyone, didn't you?
Even if you hide it… everyone will find out sooner or later!
Not you too, Captain…

By the way…

what about the kaiju…?
It's dead as a doornail!

Is it?

To my eyes, it looked like it burrowed deep underground right as the explosion went off…
What…!?
What a monster… even after taking all that punishment?
Captain! Let's call for backup!! Oka, I'm counting on you…

uncertain: U13301/U13308: choice rows with two options; each option kept in double quotes on one line since \n is not allowed. The insert tool may need to split options.
U13312: Tobei talking about Ide in the third person after Ide leaves.
U13325: ケンタウルス星 rendered 'the Centaurus star'.
U13363-U13368: this scene contradicts U13343-U13349 (Akane alive and protected by Oka); likely an alternate outcome branch. Translated as written.
U13354: Arashi reads the epitaph aloud; put in quotes.
